controlled_revision.change: Missing scopes/aliases and missing context with both endpoints general are repair diagnostics. Actual unsupported/nonempty incomplete scope, unsupported aliases, and detached required context with a scoped endpoint remain critical. Compare labels casefolded while retaining case-exact source evidence. Undefined metadata precision/recall is null.
controlled_revision.comparability: Grader classification correction, not extraction improvement. No candidate outputs or paid observations had been seen. Carry no prior candidate observations forward as rerun evidence.
controlled_revision.unchanged: Source bytes/hashes, reference.json bytes/hash, atom spans, expected query labels, partitions, thresholds and original smoke are unchanged.
controlled_revision.review_limit: Parent reports bounded cross-critique and accepted criterion; this note does not claim independent human/domain review.

baseline_refinement.reason: Development observations found late declarations restricting unheaded preambles, semicolon aliases treated as one literal, and unmodelled cross-section qualifications.
baseline_refinement.change: Respect heading-only scope boundaries and the specified semicolon grammar. Add explicit conservative same-source context co-return edges; these are not asserted engineering dependencies and may prevent useful narrowing until editorial review.
baseline_refinement.comparability: Post-observation, evaluation-exposed implementation refinement, not a fresh blind comparison. Thresholds, query expectations, atom/reference/source bytes and partition membership remain unchanged.

scenario_limits: B03 is the actual maintenance/edit path, not isolation. Isolation supports B01/D04 and component gates. B02 requires the separate downstream change experiment.
exposure: AI-authored and AI-exposed synthetic reference, not independently blind or human certified. Evaluation source labels must not enter production or development tuning.

baseline.unitizer: Validate UTF-8 strictly; bytes.splitlines(keepends=True), without decoding/re-encoding or stripping BOM/CRLF. Consecutive IDs u0001, u0002, ... in byte order. Empty input is rejected.
baseline.groups: Preamble then Markdown ATX heading sections; headings inside fenced code are ordinary text. Opening fence is at most three spaces followed by at least three backticks or tildes; matching closing fence uses the same character with at least the opening length. A heading begins a group and belongs to that group. No source-specific branches.
baseline.metadata: Outside fences only, an entire stripped line Scope: <literal> or Equipment: <literal> declares one literal scope for its heading group, never for an unheaded preamble. Aliases: <literal>[; <literal>...] declares source-literal aliases for the single scope in that group. Leading UTF-8 BOM is ignored only for grammar recognition, never removed from bytes. Empty, conflicting or ambiguous declarations stay general/unresolved. No inferred synonyms or prose scopes. Conservative same-source star edges co-return context with endpoint-byte evidence; they do not assert inferred engineering dependencies.
baseline.matching: Unicode casefold exact type/alias match; lexical additions disabled in the initial pinned strategy. Required context closes bidirectionally. Unknown subject, unreviewed scope or no scoped match broadens to all eligible. Conservative source-context co-return is disclosed as conservative_expansion, not selective qualification. Shared selector for C0/C1.
